modinfo.author: Tommy
modinfo.title: CD Food Cooldown vanilla + Full Eat Animation
modinfo.description: Leaves the food cooldown at vanilla (1s) and gives Normal difficulty the Hard-mode use action for all 548 consumables (food, herbs, insects, holy water), so the eating animation plays out. Built for Crimson Desert 2.03.02. Field-name (V3) mod: DMM locates each field itself, so it survives game updates that move data.
